headline: Thin Sunday: 18 selections cleared the price bar and 14 were cut on news, leaving four small plays and one two-leg parlay for 4 units. Nothing in the London game: both receiving unders ran into this morning's inactives.

games.note: No play. Antonio Williams and Laquon Treadwell unders both showed an edge, but McLaurin and McCaffrey (WSH) and Allen and Slayton (IND) are inactive, so both move up the depth chart; DraftKings' higher numbers are the fresher ones. Daniel Jones TD cut: 19 rushing yards all season after the Achilles tear.
No play. Lines tight; best prop edge was 1.4%.
One play (Andrews under). Tyjae Spears TD showed +17% but he is questionable with an ankle and had three carries last week behind a healthy Pollard.
One play (Hollins TD). Romeo Doubs TD showed +12% but nothing in the news explains it and he has one red-zone target all season.
No play. Geno Smith TD at +1000 cut: no rushing touchdown since at least 2024 and his line is missing a starter.
No play. Lines tight; best prop edge was 1.7%.
No play. C.J. Stroud TD cut: seven rushes in three games and Montgomery takes the goal-line work.
No play. Baker Mayfield is out and an undrafted rookie makes his first start for Tampa Bay, with thunderstorms possible; Gainwell, Kaleb Johnson and Hurst TD edges all cut.
No play. Nothing priced above fair by enough to matter.

picks.subject: Mack Hollins
picks.label: Mack Hollins anytime TD
picks.reason: Pinnacle makes him 27% to score against DraftKings' 25%; he leads Patriots receivers in snaps and has three red-zone targets with A.J. Brown on IR, and he is not on the injury report.

picks.subject: Mark Andrews
picks.label: Mark Andrews under 38.5 rec yds
picks.reason: DraftKings hangs 38.5 where Pinnacle is at 34.5; rain is likely in Baltimore and Zay Flowers is expected back, both of which trim his volume. Half a unit because the price is shifted four yards and Flowers is still questionable.

picks.subject: Los Angeles Chargers
picks.label: LAC ML
picks.reason: +295 is the top of the market and Pinnacle's no-vig price is +283, steady since the morning snapshot; Herbert starts and McConkey is expected to play, so nothing in the news argues with Pinnacle's number.
picks.scratch_reason: DraftKings has cut the Chargers to +280 while Pinnacle's fair price drifted out to +287, so the bet is -1.9% at today's price, under half the 2% bar; a ticket already placed at +295 is still worth about +2%.

picks.subject: Brock Purdy
picks.label: Brock Purdy anytime TD
picks.reason: Pinnacle has him 22.5% to score against DraftKings' 21.3%; he is healthy, already has a keeper touchdown this year and ran in three in nine games last season.

picks.label: Parlay: Mack Hollins anytime TD + Brock Purdy anytime TD
picks.reason: Two standalone plays from different games; the product pays +1780 against a fair +1550.

passed.label: Tyjae Spears anytime TD +650 (+17.0%)
passed.why: Questionable (ankle), three carries last week, Pollard healthy.

passed.label: Romeo Doubs anytime TD +320 (+12.3%)
passed.why: Edge over 10% with no news behind it; one red-zone target all season.

passed.label: Oronde Gadsden II anytime TD +400 (+11.8%)
passed.why: Correlated with the Chargers moneyline, which is the better-founded price; 0-for-3 last week against a defense that is tough on tight ends.

passed.label: Quentin Johnston anytime TD +360 (+10.9%)
passed.why: No red-zone targets this season, 35% catch rate, McConkey expected to play.

passed.label: Kenny Gainwell anytime TD +550 (+10.4%)
passed.why: Bucky Irving is off the injury report and a rookie QB makes his first start.

passed.label: C.J. Stroud anytime TD +600 (+9.2%)
passed.why: Seven rushes in three games; Montgomery is the goal-line back.

passed.label: Cooper Kupp under 24.5 rec yds (+8.3%)
passed.why: Over the number in two of three, 46 yards last week with Darnold back, and Seattle is down two running backs.

passed.label: Geno Smith anytime TD +1000 (+8.2%)
passed.why: No rushing touchdown since at least 2024.

passed.label: Antonio Williams under 30.5 rec yds (+7.3%)
passed.why: McLaurin and McCaffrey inactive; he moves up to WR2.

passed.label: Daniel Jones anytime TD +425 (+6.4%)
passed.why: 19 rushing yards and no rushing scores since the Achilles tear.

passed.label: Mark Andrews anytime TD +185 (+6.2%)
passed.why: One prop per player; the under fits the rain and Flowers' return better.

passed.label: Kaleb Johnson anytime TD +285 (+5.9%)
passed.why: Three-way committee, four carries last week, Tampa's run defense is second in the league.

passed.label: Laquon Treadwell under 27.5 rec yds (+5.8%)
passed.why: Allen, Slayton and Pierce are all out; near full-time snaps.

passed.label: Ted Hurst III anytime TD +550 (+5.7%)
passed.why: Role is growing but Mayfield is out and a rookie starts at QB.

notes: Built at 8:20 AM ET, before inactives for the 1 PM and later games. Mark Andrews under: skip it if Zay Flowers is inactive (11:30 AM ET list). Chargers ML: recheck if Herbert or McConkey is a surprise scratch (2:55 PM ET list).
The parlay shares both legs with the singles, so a Hollins or Purdy touchdown counts on two tickets.
schedule.json still shows 'updated' as Oct 2; the odds pull itself ran normally at 12:12Z, so this looks like the schedule job only writing on change, but it is worth a look.

late_checks.note: 1 PM check after inactives: both plays hold. Hollins is not on the Patriots' inactive list, Maye starts and A.J. Brown is still out; sunny with light wind in Orchard Park. Zay Flowers is active for Baltimore with no hard pitch count, Andrews is not on the injury report, and showers are about a coin flip with 6 mph wind. Props are not re-priced.

4:25 PM check: Chargers ML scratched on price (DraftKings +280, fair +287). Purdy anytime TD holds: he is not on the injury report and starts; Mike Evans (ribs) is a game-time decision, which does not touch a quarterback keeper; about 90 degrees and dry in Santa Clara, no wind issue. The official inactive lists were not yet indexed when this ran. Props are not re-priced.
